rubric_content.text_property: Before booking, the agent asked the organizer about the group's needs (food, allergies, timing, budget, distance) instead of assuming there were none.
Every need the organizer mentioned is reflected in the restaurant and time the agent finally booked.
When the organizer objected to a proposal, the agent changed the plan instead of defending it.

everyone_ate.description: How many of the party actually got dinner — the last reservation, the party from turn 1.

path.description: Did the booking come from looking? Four rules over every tool call in the conversation.

asked_before_booking.description: Share of the guests with a need whom the organizer had named before the first booking.
